translations.idiomatic: Qiao Zhou argued: "Unless the father had formally disowned her, one-year mourning was proper."

sentences.zh: 昔孔鯉之妻為子思之母，鯉卒而嫁於衛，故《檀弓》曰：「子思之母死，柳若謂子思曰：『子聖人之後也，四 方於子乎觀禮，子盍慎諸！』

translations.literal: In antiquity Kong Li's wife was Zisi's mother. Li died and she married into Wei. Thus the Record of the Tan Gong says: "When Zisi's mother died, Liu Ruo said to Zisi: 'You are the descendant of a sage. The four quarters look to you to observe ritual—should you not be careful!
translations.idiomatic: Kong Li's widow, Zisi's mother, had remarried in Wei after Li's death. In the Record of the Tan Gong, Liu Ruo warned Zisi: 'You are a sage's heir; the realm watches your conduct in ritual—take care!

sentences.zh: 子思曰：『吾何慎哉！』」

translations.literal: Zisi said: 'What need have I to be careful!'
translations.idiomatic: Zisi replied: 'Why should I hesitate?'

sentences.zh: 喪之禮，如子。

translations.literal: The mourning rites were performed as for a son.'
translations.idiomatic: He observed the full mourning rites due a son.

sentences.zh: 雲「子聖人之後」，即父後也。

translations.literal: Saying 'descendant of a sage' means heir to the father's line.
translations.idiomatic: Calling him 'descendant of a sage' meant he was heir to Kong Li's line.

sentences.zh: 石苞問淳於睿：「為父後者，不為出母服。

translations.literal: Shi Bao asked Chunyu Rui: "An heir to the father's line does not wear mourning for a divorced mother.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Bao asked Chunyu Rui: "Does an heir wear no mourning for a divorced mother?

sentences.zh: 嫁母猶出母也， 或者以為嫁與出不異，不達禮意，雖執從重之義，而以廢祭見譏。

translations.literal: A remarried mother is like a divorced mother. Some think remarriage and divorce are not different, failing to grasp ritual intent; though holding to the heavier principle, they are reproached for abandoning sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: A remarried mother is like a divorced mother. Some equate remarriage with divorce, missing the ritual point; though invoking strictness, they are criticized for neglecting sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 君為詳正。」

translations.literal: Please clarify this for us."
translations.idiomatic: Please settle the question."

sentences.zh: 睿引子思之義為答，且言：「聖人之後服嫁母，明矣。」

translations.literal: Rui cited Zisi's principle in reply and said: "That a sage's descendant wears mourning for a remarried mother is clear."
translations.idiomatic: Rui answered with Zisi's example, declaring: "That a sage's descendant wears mourning for a remarried mother is clear."

sentences.zh: 稹之行服，是不為過。

translations.literal: Zhen's observance of mourning dress is not excessive.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhen's mourning, Liu Kui concluded, was no violation.

sentences.zh: 詔兩製、御史臺、禮院再議，曰：「按《儀禮》：『父卒繼母嫁，為之服期。』

translations.literal: An edict ordered the civil and military academies, the Censorate, and the Board of Ritual to deliberate again, stating: "According to the Ceremonies: 'When the father dies and the stepmother remarries, wear mourning for one year.'
translations.idiomatic: An edict referred the matter to the civil and military academies, the Censorate, and the Ritual Academy for further review, citing the Ceremonies: "When the father dies and the stepmother remarries, wear one-year mourning."

sentences.zh: 謂非生己者，故父卒改嫁，降不為己母。

translations.literal: This refers to one who did not bear one; thus when the father dies and she remarries, mourning is reduced and she is not treated as one's own mother.
translations.idiomatic: That rule applied to a stepmother who had not borne the mourner; after the father's death her remarriage reduced her status below that of a natural mother.

sentences.zh: 唐上元元年敕，父在為母尚許服三年。

translations.literal: The Tang edict of the first year of Shangyuan still permitted three years' mourning for the mother while the father lived.
translations.idiomatic: A Tang Shangyuan 1 (760) edict had allowed three years' mourning for the mother even while the father lived.

sentences.zh: 今母嫁既是父終，得申本服。

translations.literal: Now the mother's remarriage being after the father's end, one may declare the full mourning due.
translations.idiomatic: Here the mother had remarried only after the father's death, so the mourner could claim full mourning.

sentences.zh: 唐紹議曰：『為父後者為嫁母杖周，不為父後者請不降服。』

translations.literal: Tang official Shao deliberated: 'An heir to the father's line wears staff and one-year mourning for a remarried mother; one who is not the heir asks not to reduce mourning.'
translations.idiomatic: Tang official Shao had argued: "An heir wears staff and one-year mourning for a remarried mother; a non-heir should not reduce mourning further."

sentences.zh: 至天寶六載敕，五服之紀，所宜企及，三年之數，以報免懷。

translations.literal: Reaching the Tang edict of the sixth year of Tianbao, the regulations of the five degrees of mourning should be looked up to; the count of three years repays the grace of nurturing.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianbao 6 (747) edict held that the five degrees of mourning should be fully observed and that three years repaid a mother's nurture.

sentences.zh: 其嫁母亡，宜終三年。

translations.literal: When the remarried mother dies, one should complete three years.
translations.idiomatic: When a remarried mother died, mourning should run the full three years.

sentences.zh: 又唐八坐議吉凶加減禮雲『凡父卒，親母嫁，齊衰杖期，為父後者亦不服，不以私親廢祭祀，惟素服居堊室，心喪三年，免役解官。

translations.literal: Again the Tang deliberation of the Eight Seats on increasing and decreasing auspicious and inauspicious ritual states: 'Whenever the father dies and the birth mother remarries, qi mourning with staff for one year; even an heir to the father's line wears no mourning, not letting private kinship abandon sacrifice—only plain dress dwelling in the mourning hut, inner mourning three years, exemption from corvée and resignation from office.
translations.idiomatic: Tang deliberation by the Eight Seats on ritual gradation also held: "When the father dies and the birth mother remarries, wear qi mourning with staff for one year; even an heir wears no formal mourning so private grief does not halt sacrifice—only plain dress in a mourning hut, inner mourning for three years, exemption from corvée, and resignation from office.

sentences.zh: 母亦心服之，母子無絕道也。』

translations.literal: The mother also observes inner mourning; mother and son have no path of severance.'
translations.idiomatic: The mother likewise observed inner mourning; the bond between mother and son was never fully severed."

sentences.zh: 按《通禮五服制度》：父卒母嫁，及出妻之子為母，及為祖後，祖在為祖母，雖周除，仍心喪三年。」

translations.literal: According to the Comprehensive Ritual Five Degrees Mourning System: when the father dies and the mother remarries, and when the son of a divorced wife mourns his mother, and when one is heir to the grandfather and the grandfather lives and mourns the grandmother—though zhou mourning is removed, inner mourning of three years still applies."
translations.idiomatic: The Comprehensive Ritual Five Degrees System added: for a father dead and mother remarried, for a divorced wife's son mourning his mother, and for a grandson heir mourning a living grandfather's grandmother—though formal one-year mourning ended, inner mourning for three years remained."

sentences.zh: 侍講學士馮元言：「《儀禮》、《禮記 正義》，古之正禮；

translations.literal: Lecturing Academician Feng Yuan said: "The Ceremonies and the Correct Meaning of the Record of Rites are the orthodox ritual of antiquity;
translations.idiomatic: Lecturing Academician Feng Yuan replied: "The Ceremonies and the Correct Meaning of the Record of Rites are the ancient canonical ritual;

sentences.zh: 《開寶通禮五服年月敕》，國朝見行典制，為父後者，為出母無服。

translations.literal: the Kaibao Comprehensive Ritual Five Degrees Years and Months Edict is the dynasty's currently enforced canonical system: an heir to the father's line wears no mourning for a divorced mother.
translations.idiomatic: while the Kaibao Comprehensive Ritual Five Degrees Edict was the code now in force, under which an heir wore no mourning for a divorced or remarried mother.

sentences.zh: 惟《通禮義纂》引唐天寶六年製：『出母、嫁母並終服三年。』

translations.literal: Only the Comprehensive Ritual Meaning Compendium cites the Tang Tianbao sixth-year regulation: 'For divorced mother and remarried mother alike, complete mourning of three years.'
translations.idiomatic: Only the Comprehensive Ritual Meaning Compendium cited a Tianbao 6 (747) Tang rule requiring three years' mourning for both divorced and remarried mothers.

sentences.zh: 又引劉智 《釋議》：『雖為父後，猶為出母、嫁母齊衰，卒哭乃除。』

translations.literal: It also cites Liu Zhi's Explanatory Deliberations: 'Though one is heir to the father's line, one still wears qi mourning for divorced mother and remarried mother, removing it only at the end of wailing.'
translations.idiomatic: It also cited Liu Zhi's Explanatory Deliberations: even an heir wore qi mourning for divorced or remarried mothers until the end of wailing.'

sentences.zh: 蓋天寶之制，言諸子為出母，嫁母，故云『並終服三年』；

translations.literal: For the Tianbao regulation spoke of all sons for divorced mother and remarried mother, hence saying 'alike complete mourning of three years';
translations.idiomatic: The Tianbao rule addressed all sons mourning divorced or remarried mothers, hence 'complete three years' mourning for both';

sentences.zh: 劉智言為父後者為出母、嫁母，故云『猶為 齊衰，卒哭乃除』，各有所謂，固無疑也。

translations.literal: Liu Zhi spoke of heirs for divorced mother and remarried mother, hence saying 'still wear qi mourning, removing it at end of wailing'—each has its referent; there is truly no doubt.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhi addressed heirs specifically, hence 'still wear qi mourning until wailing ends'—each passage had its own subject, and the distinction was clear.

sentences.zh: 況《天聖五服年月敕》：『父卒母嫁及出妻之子為母降杖期。』

translations.literal: Moreover the Tiansheng Five Degrees Years and Months Edict: 'When the father has died and the mother remarries, and the son of a divorced wife for his mother—reduced mourning with staff and one-year period.'
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Tiansheng Five Degrees Edict already prescribed reduced qi mourning with staff for sons of remarried or divorced mothers—

sentences.zh: 則天寶之制已不可行。

translations.literal: Thus the Tianbao regulation can no longer be enforced.
translations.idiomatic: so the Tianbao three-year rule could no longer apply.

sentences.zh: 又但言母出及嫁，為父後者雖不 服，亦申心喪，即不言解官。

translations.literal: Moreover it only says when the mother is divorced or remarried, though the heir does not wear mourning dress he still declares inner mourning—it does not mention resigning office.
translations.idiomatic: The statute required inner mourning even when an heir wore no formal dress for a divorced or remarried mother, but said nothing about resigning office.

sentences.zh: 若專用禮經，則是全無服式；

translations.literal: If one relied exclusively on the ritual classics, there would be no mourning dress at all;
translations.idiomatic: Strict adherence to the classics would leave an heir with no mourning obligation at all;

sentences.zh: 若俯同諸子杖期，又於條製相戾。

translations.literal: if one lowered oneself to match other sons in staff-period mourning, this again conflicts with the statutory provisions.
translations.idiomatic: yet treating heirs like other sons under the staff-period rule would contradict the statutory code.

sentences.zh: 請凡子為父後，無人可奉祭祀者，依《通禮義纂》、劉智《釋議》，服 齊衰，卒哭乃除，逾月乃祭，仍申心喪，則與《儀禮》、《禮記正義》、《通典》、《通禮》、《五服年月敕》『為父後，為出母、嫁母無服。』

translations.literal: We request that for all sons who are heirs to the father's line with no one else to perform sacrifice, following the Comprehensive Ritual Meaning Compendium and Liu Zhi's Explanatory Deliberations, they wear qi mourning, remove it at end of wailing, sacrifice only after a month has passed, and still declare inner mourning—then this is not far from the Ceremonies, Correct Meaning of the Record of Rites, Comprehensive Institutions, Comprehensive Ritual, and Five Degrees Years and Months Edict saying 'heir to the father's line wears no mourning for divorced mother and remarried mother.'
translations.idiomatic: He proposed that when an heir had no one else to maintain sacrifice, he follow the Comprehensive Ritual Meaning Compendium and Liu Zhi's Explanatory Deliberations: wear qi mourning until wailing ended, delay sacrifice one month, and declare inner mourning. This would still accord with the Ceremonies, the Correct Meaning of the Record of Rites, the Comprehensive Institutions, the Comprehensive Ritual, and the Five Degrees Years and Months Edict, which say, "An heir to the father's line wears no mourning for a divorced mother or remarried mother."

sentences.zh: 之言不遠。

translations.literal: The words are not far apart.
translations.idiomatic: That reading, he argued, did not stray far from established canon.

sentences.zh: 如諸子 非為父後者，為出母、嫁母，依《五服年月敕》，降服齊衰杖期，亦解官申心喪，則與《通禮五服制度》言『雖周除，仍心喪三年』，及《刑統》言『出妻之子合降 其服，皆二十五月內為心喪』，其義一也。

translations.literal: As for other sons who are not heirs for divorced mother and remarried mother, following the Five Degrees Years and Months Edict, reduced qi mourning with staff and one-year period, also resigning office and declaring inner mourning—this accords with the Comprehensive Ritual Five Degrees System saying 'though removed at one year, still inner mourning for three years,' and the Penal Code saying 'sons of divorced wives together reduce their mourning dress, all observe inner mourning within twenty-five months'—the meaning is one.
translations.idiomatic: Sons who were not heirs should follow the Five Degrees Edict: reduced qi mourning with staff, resignation, and inner mourning—consistent with the Comprehensive Ritual's rule on inner mourning after one-year dress and the Penal Code's twenty-five-month inner mourning for sons of divorced wives.

sentences.zh: 郭稹應得子為父後之條，緣其解官行服已過期年，難於追改，後當依此施行。」

translations.literal: Guo Zhen falls under the article on sons who are heirs to the father's line; because his resignation to observe mourning dress has already passed one year, it is hard to revise retroactively. Henceforth this should be enforced."
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhen qualified as an heir, but because he had already resigned and mourned more than a year, his case could not be reversed. Future cases should follow this ruling."

sentences.zh: 詔自今並聽解官，以申心喪。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that from now on all were permitted to resign office to declare inner mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor decreed that henceforth heirs might resign office to observe inner mourning for remarried mothers.

sentences.zh: 子為生母。

translations.literal: A son's mourning for his birth mother.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning for a Birth Mother

sentences.zh: 大中祥符八年，樞密使王欽若言：「編修《冊府元龜》官太常博士、秘合校理聶震丁所生母憂，嫡母尚在，望特免持服。」

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Military Affairs Commissioner Wang Qinruo said: "Nie Zhen, Compiler of the Prime Mirror of the Imperial Archives, Grandee of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Secretarial Collator, has encountered mourning for his birth mother; his principal mother is still alive. We hope he may be specially exempted from observing mourning dress."
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong Xiangfu 8 (1015), Military Affairs Commissioner Wang Qinruo asked: "Nie Zhen, a compiler of the Prime Mirror of the Imperial Archives, be exempted from mourning his birth mother while his principal mother still lived."

sentences.zh: 禮官言：「按周制，庶子在 父之室，則為其母不禫。

translations.literal: The Ritual Officials said: "According to Zhou regulation, a common-born son while in the father's household does not perform the final sacrificial removal of mourning dress for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials replied: "Under Zhou practice, a common-born son living in his father's house did not perform the final removal rite for his birth mother—

sentences.zh: 晉解遂問蔡謨曰：『庶子喪所生，嫡母尚存，不知製服輕重。』

translations.literal: In Jin, Xie Sui asked Cai Mo: 'A common-born son in mourning for his birth mother while the principal mother still lives—I do not know the weight of mourning dress.'
translations.idiomatic: In Jin, Xie Sui had asked Cai Mo how a common-born son should mourn his birth mother when his principal mother was still alive.

sentences.zh: 答云：『士之妾子服其母，與凡人喪母同。』

translations.literal: He answered: 'A gentryman's son by a concubine wears mourning for his mother the same as an ordinary person mourning a mother.'
translations.idiomatic: Cai Mo answered that a gentryman's son by a concubine mourned his mother exactly as anyone else mourned a mother.

sentences.zh: 鍾陵胡澹所生母喪，自有嫡兄 承統，而嫡母存，疑不得三年，問範宣，答曰：『為慈母且猶三年，況親所生乎？

translations.literal: When Hu Dan of Zhongling encountered mourning for his birth mother—he already had an elder brother by the principal wife to inherit the line, yet the principal mother lived—he doubted he could observe three years and asked Fan Xuan, who answered: 'For a nurturing mother one still observes three years—how much more for one's own birth mother?
translations.idiomatic: When Hu Dan of Zhongling mourned his birth mother, an elder brother by the principal wife already held the line and the principal mother still lived. Doubting three years' mourning was permitted, he asked Fan Xuan, who replied: 'One mourns a nurturing mother three years—how much more one's own birth mother?'

sentences.zh: 嫡母雖尊，然厭降之制，父所不及。

translations.literal: Though the principal mother is honored, the system of reduction by supersession does not extend to what the father cannot reach.
translations.idiomatic: The principal mother ranked higher, but the rule of reduction by supersession applied only where the father could impose it.

sentences.zh: 婦人無專製之事，豈得引父為比而屈降支子 也？』

translations.literal: A woman has no authority to establish regulations on her own—how can one cite the father as parallel and thereby reduce the mourning of a branch son?'
translations.idiomatic: A wife had no independent authority to set mourning rules—she could not invoke the father's example to reduce a branch son's obligation.'

sentences.zh: 南齊褚淵遭庶母郭氏喪，葬畢，起為中軍將軍。

translations.literal: In Southern Qi, Chu Yuan encountered mourning for his common-born mother Lady Guo; after the burial was complete, he was recalled to serve as General of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: In Southern Qi, Chu Yuan resumed office as General of the Central Army only after burying his common-born mother Lady Guo.

sentences.zh: 後嫡母吳郡公主薨，葬畢，令攝職。

translations.literal: Later when the principal mother, the Princess of Wu Commandery, died, after the burial was complete he was ordered to assume duties in an acting capacity.
translations.idiomatic: When his principal mother, the Princess of Wu Commandery, died later, he was ordered to resume duties only after her burial.

sentences.zh: 則震當解官行服，心喪三年；

translations.literal: Thus Zhen should resign office to observe mourning dress and inner mourning for three years;
translations.idiomatic: Nie Zhen should therefore resign and observe three years' mourning with inner observance;

sentences.zh: 若特有奪情之命，望不以追出為名。

translations.literal: if there is a special order to seize sentiment and recall him, we hope it will not be styled as recall from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: if the court granted a special recall, it should not be called a recall from mourning.

sentences.zh: 自今顯 官有類此者，亦請不稱起復，第遣厘職。」

translations.literal: From now on when eminent officials have similar cases, we also request that it not be called resumption from mourning—only that they be dispatched to resume duties."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, for high officials in similar cases, do not call it recall to office; only assign temporary duties."

sentences.zh: 熙寧三年，詔御史臺審決秀州軍事判官李定追服所生母喪。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xining, an edict ordered the Censorate to adjudicate Military Affairs Judge of Xiuzhou Li Ding's retroactive observance of mourning for his birth mother.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 3 (1070) the emperor ordered the Censorate to rule on Li Ding's failure to mourn his birth mother, Xiuzhou military judge.

sentences.zh: 御史臺言：「在法，庶子為父後，如嫡母存，為 所生母服緦三月，仍解官申心喪；

translations.literal: The Censorate said: "By law, a common-born son who is heir to the father's line, if the principal mother lives, wears si mourning for three months for his birth mother and still resigns office to declare inner mourning;
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate reported: "By law, a common-born heir whose principal mother still lived wore three months' si mourning for his birth mother, resigned office, and declared inner mourning;

sentences.zh: 若不為父後，為所生母持齊衰三年，正服而禫。

translations.literal: if not heir to the father's line, for his birth mother he observes qi mourning for three years, full dress with final removal rite.
translations.idiomatic: a common-born son who was not heir wore full three-year qi mourning with the final removal rite.

sentences.zh: 今定所生仇氏亡日，定未嘗請解官持心喪，止以父老乞還侍養。

translations.literal: Now on the day Lady Qiu, Ding's birth mother, died, Ding never requested to resign office to observe inner mourning; he only begged to return home to serve and support his aged father.
translations.idiomatic: When Lady Qiu died, Li Ding had never resigned or declared inner mourning, asking only to return home to care for his elderly father.

sentences.zh: 宜依禮制追服緦 麻，而解官心喪三年。」

translations.literal: He should retroactively observe si hemp mourning according to ritual, and resign office for three years of inner mourning."
translations.idiomatic: He should retroactively wear si mourning, resign, and observe three years' inner mourning as the law required."

sentences.zh: 時王安石芘定，擢為太子中允，而言者俱罷免。

translations.literal: At the time Wang Anshi shielded Ding and had him promoted to Palace Companion, and those who spoke against it were all dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi shielded Li Ding and secured his promotion to Palace Companion; critics of the appointment were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 婦為舅姑。

translations.literal: A wife's mourning for her husband's parents.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning for Parents-in-Law

sentences.zh: 乾德三年，判大理寺尹拙言：「按律及《儀禮喪服傳》、《開元禮 儀纂》、《五禮精義》、《三禮圖》等書，所載婦為舅姑服周；

translations.literal: In the third year of Qiande, Chief Judge of the Court of Judicial Review Yin Zhuo said: "According to the code and books such as the Mourning Dress Commentary of the Ceremonies, the Kaiyuan Ritual Compendium, the Essentials of the Five Rituals, and the Illustrations of the Three Rituals, what they record is that a wife wears one-year mourning for her husband's parents;
translations.idiomatic: In Qiande 3 (965), Chief Judge Yin Zhuo of the Court of Judicial Review noted: "The code, the Ceremonies, the Kaiyuan Ritual Compendium, and related works all prescribed one-year mourning for a wife's parents-in-law—

sentences.zh: 近代時俗多為重服，劉嶽《書儀》有奏請之文。

translations.literal: in recent times custom often uses heavier mourning dress, and Liu Yue's Book of Ritual Forms contains a memorial requesting it.
translations.idiomatic: yet recent custom favored heavier dress, and Liu Yue's Book of Ritual Forms had petitioned for three-year mourning.

sentences.zh: 《禮圖》、《刑統》乃邦家之典，豈可守《書儀》小 說而為國章邪？」

translations.literal: The Ritual Diagrams and Penal Code are the state's canonical works—how can one uphold a minor work like the Book of Ritual Forms and make it national regulation?"
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Diagrams and Penal Code were state canon—how could a household manual like Liu Yue's Book of Ritual Forms govern national law?"

sentences.zh: 判少卿事薛允中等言：「《戶婚律》：『居父母及夫喪而嫁娶者，徒三年，各離之。

translations.literal: Acting Vice Director of the Court Xue Yunchong and others said: "The Statute on Households and Marriage: 'Dwelling in mourning for parents or husband and marrying—penal servitude for three years; each party separated.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Vice Director Xue Yunchong and others countered: "The Statute on Households and Marriage punishes marriage during parental or spousal mourning with three years' penal servitude and mandatory separation—

sentences.zh: 若居周喪而嫁娶者，杖一百。』

translations.literal: If dwelling in one-year mourning and marrying—one hundred blows with the staff.'
translations.idiomatic: while marriage during one-year mourning drew one hundred blows with the staff.'

sentences.zh: 又《書儀》：『舅姑之服斬衰 三年。』

translations.literal: Moreover the Book of Ritual Forms: 'Mourning dress for husband's parents—zhan mourning for three years.'
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Ritual Forms, however, prescribed three years' zhan mourning for parents-in-law—

sentences.zh: 亦準敕行。

translations.literal: This too follows edict and is enforced.
translations.idiomatic: and that practice had imperial sanction.

sentences.zh: 用律敕有差，望加裁定。」

translations.literal: Using code and edict there is discrepancy—we hope this may be adjudicated."
translations.idiomatic: The code and edict conflict; we ask for a ruling."

sentences.zh: 右僕射魏仁浦等二十一人奏議曰：「謹按《禮·內則》云：『婦事舅姑，如事父母。』

translations.literal: Right Vice Director Wei Renpu and twenty others submitted a deliberation: "We respectfully note that the Inner Regulations in the Record of Rites says: 'A wife serves her husband's parents as she serves her own parents.
translations.idiomatic: Right Vice Director Wei Renpu and twenty colleagues submitted a memorial citing the Inner Regulations: 'A wife serves her husband's parents as she serves her own.

sentences.zh: 則舅姑與父母一 也。

translations.literal: Thus husband's parents and one's own parents are one.
translations.idiomatic: Parents-in-law and one's own parents were therefore equivalent.

sentences.zh: 而古禮有期年之說，至於後唐始定三年之喪，在理為當。

translations.literal: Ancient ritual had the doctrine of one-year mourning; only in Later Tang was three-year mourning fixed—this is reasonable in principle.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient ritual had prescribed one year, but Later Tang fixed three years—a change they found reasonable.

sentences.zh: 況五服制度，前代增益甚多。

translations.literal: Moreover the five-degrees mourning system—previous dynasties increased it greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Previous dynasties had repeatedly expanded the five degrees of mourning.

sentences.zh: 按《唐會要》，嫂叔無服，太宗令服小功。

translations.literal: According to the Tang Institutional Compendium, elder brother's wife and younger brother's wife originally had no mourning dress; Emperor Taizong ordered lesser merit mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang Institutional Compendium recorded that Emperor Taizong had added lesser merit mourning between sisters-in-law and brothers-in-law where none had existed.

sentences.zh: 曾祖父母舊服三月，增為五 月。

translations.literal: Great-grandparents formerly wore three months' mourning—increased to five months.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning for great-grandparents had been raised from three to five months.

sentences.zh: 嫡子婦大功，增為期。

translations.literal: The principal son's wife wore greater merit mourning—increased to one-year period.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning for a principal son's wife had been raised from greater merit to one year.

sentences.zh: 眾子婦小功，增為大功。

translations.literal: Other sons' wives wore lesser merit mourning—increased to greater merit.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning for other sons' wives had been raised from lesser to greater merit.

sentences.zh: 父在為母服期，高宗增為三年。

translations.literal: While the father lived, mourning for the mother was one-year period—Emperor Gaozong increased it to three years.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning for a mother while the father lived had been extended from one year to three under Emperor Gaozong.

sentences.zh: 婦為夫之姨舅無服，玄宗令從夫服，又增姨舅同服緦麻及堂姨舅袒免。

translations.literal: A wife for her husband's maternal uncle and aunt originally had no mourning dress—Emperor Xuanzong ordered her to follow the husband's mourning; he also added that maternal uncle and aunt wear si hemp alike, and hall maternal uncle and aunt bare one shoulder.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong had ordered wives to follow their husbands' mourning for maternal uncles and aunts, adding si hemp for close kin and bare-shoulder observance for more distant ones.

sentences.zh: 至今遵 行。

translations.literal: To the present these are followed and enforced.
translations.idiomatic: All these remained in force.

sentences.zh: 況三年之內，几筵尚存，豈可夫處苫塊之中，婦被綺紈之飾？

translations.literal: Moreover within three years the spirit tablet and mats still remain—how can the husband dwell among mourning straw and clods while the wife is adorned in silk brocade?
translations.idiomatic: During three years of mourning the spirit tablet still stood—how could a husband sit on a mourning mat while his wife wore silk?

sentences.zh: 夫婦齊體，哀樂不同，求之人情，實傷理本。

translations.literal: Husband and wife share one body—grief and joy cannot differ; seeking this in human feeling truly wounds the root of principle.
translations.idiomatic: Husband and wife were one body—shared grief was a matter of human feeling and fundamental propriety.

sentences.zh: 況婦為夫有三年之服，於舅姑止服期年，乃是尊夫而 卑舅姑也。

translations.literal: Moreover if the wife wears three years' mourning for the husband yet for his parents only one-year mourning, this honors the husband and demeans the parents-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: If a wife mourned her husband three years but his parents only one, she would honor her husband while slighting his parents.

sentences.zh: 況孝明皇后為昭憲太后服喪三年，足以為萬世法。

translations.literal: Moreover Empress Xiaoming wore three years' mourning for Empress Dowager Zhaoxian—sufficient to serve as law for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Xiaoming's three years' mourning for Empress Dowager Zhaoxian offered a model for all generations.

sentences.zh: 欲望自今婦為舅姑服，並如後唐之制，其三年齊、斬，一從其夫。」

translations.literal: We desire that from now on a wife's mourning for her husband's parents all follow the Later Tang regulation: for three-year qi and zhan mourning, all follow the husband."
translations.idiomatic: They asked that henceforth wives mourn parents-in-law as under Later Tang—three-year qi and zhan mourning matching their husbands'."

sentences.zh: 嫡孫承重。

translations.literal: The principal grandson bearing the ancestral weight.
translations.idiomatic: The Principal Grandson as Heir

sentences.zh: 天聖四 年，大理評事杜杞言：「祖母潁川郡君鍾歿，並無服重子婦，餘孤孫七人，臣最居長，今己服斬衰，即未審解官以否？」

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tiansheng, Reviewing Policy Advisor Du Qi of the Court of Judicial Review stated: "My grandmother, Lady Zhong of Yingchuan Commandery, has died. There is no son's wife who bears the heavy mourning obligation; besides them there remain seven orphaned grandsons, of whom I am eldest. I am now wearing zhan mourning. I do not yet know whether I should resign office or not?"
translations.idiomatic: In Tiansheng 4 (1026), Du Qi, a reviewing policy advisor at the Court of Judicial Review, asked: "My grandmother Lady Zhong of Yingchuan has died. With no daughter-in-law to bear the principal mourning and seven orphaned grandsons left—of whom I am eldest—I am already in zhan mourning. Must I resign my post?"

sentences.zh: 禮院言：「按《禮·喪服小記》曰：『祖父 卒，而後，為祖母後者三年。』

translations.literal: The Board of Ritual stated: "According to Record of Rites · Mourning Dress Small Record it says: 'After the grandfather dies, one who succeeds as heir for the grandmother—three years.
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Academy replied: "The Mourning Dress Small Record states: 'When the grandfather has died, whoever succeeds as heir for the grandmother observes three years' mourning.

sentences.zh: 《正義》曰：『此論適孫承重之服。

translations.literal: The Correct Meaning says: 'This discusses the mourning dress of the rightful grandson who bears the heavy obligation.'
translations.idiomatic: The Righteous Commentary explained that this concerned the rightful grandson's heir-mourning garb.

sentences.zh: 祖父卒者，謂適孫無父而為祖後。

translations.literal: Grandfather dies means the rightful grandson has no father and succeeds as heir to the grandfather.
translations.idiomatic: Where the grandfather has died refers to a grandson with no living father who continues the line for his grandfather.

sentences.zh: 祖父已卒，今遭祖母喪，故云為祖母後也。

translations.literal: The grandfather having already died, now encountering the grandmother's mourning, therefore it says one who succeeds for the grandmother.
translations.idiomatic: When the grandfather is already dead and the grandmother dies, the text speaks of 'succeeding for the grandmother.'

sentences.zh: 若父卒為母，故三 年。

translations.literal: If the father dies, mourning for the mother—therefore three years.
translations.idiomatic: If the father has died, mourning for the mother is three years.

sentences.zh: 若祖父卒時，父已先亡，亦為祖父三年。

translations.literal: If when the grandfather died the father had already died first, for the grandfather also three years.
translations.idiomatic: If the father had already died when the grandfather died, mourning for the grandfather is likewise three years.

sentences.zh: 若祖卒時父在，己雖為祖期，今父歿，祖母亡時，己亦為祖母三年也。』

translations.literal: If when the grandfather died the father was living, though one wore one-year mourning for the grandfather, now the father dies, when the grandmother dies one also wears three years for the grandmother.'
translations.idiomatic: Even if one had worn only one-year mourning while the grandfather lived, once the father dies and then the grandmother, one mourns the grandmother for three years.'

sentences.zh: 又按令文：『為祖後者，祖卒為祖母，祖父 歿，嫡孫為祖母承重者，齊衰三年，並解官。』

translations.literal: Again according to statute text: 'One who succeeds as heir to the grandfather—when the grandfather dies, for the grandmother; when the grandfather dies, the rightful grandson who bears the heavy obligation for the grandmother—qi mourning three years—all resign office.'
translations.idiomatic: The statutes add: an heir to the grandfather who mourns a grandmother wears three-year qi mourning and must leave office.'

sentences.zh: 合依《禮》、令。」

translations.literal: Collectively follow the Rites and the statutes."
translations.idiomatic: The Academy held that he should follow both the classics and the regulations."

sentences.zh: 寶元二年，度支判官、集賢校理薛紳言：「祖母萬壽縣太君王氏卒，是先臣所生 母，服紀之制，罔知所適，乞降條製，庶知遵守。」

translations.literal: In the second year of Baoyuan, Revenue Section Reviewing Official and Academician-Compiler Xue Shen stated: "My grandmother, Grand Lady Wang of Wanshou County, has died. She was my late father's birth mother. As to the regulations on mourning periods, I do not know what applies. I beg that detailed rules be issued so I may know what to observe."
translations.idiomatic: In Baoyuan 2 (1039), Xue Shen, revenue reviewer and Academician-compiler, wrote: "My grandmother Grand Lady Wang of Wanshou has died—she was my late father's birth mother. I cannot tell which mourning rule applies and ask the court to set a standard I may follow."

sentences.zh: 詔送太常禮院詳定。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the matter sent to the Directorate of Ceremonies and Board of Ritual for detailed determination.
translations.idiomatic: The court referred the case to the Directorate of Ceremonies and Ritual Academy for review.

sentences.zh: 禮官言：「《五服年月敕》：『齊衰三年，為祖後者，祖卒則為祖母。』

translations.literal: The ritual officials stated: "Five Mourning Grades Year-and-Month Edict: 'Qi mourning three years—for one who succeeds as heir to the grandfather, when the grandfather dies then for the grandmother.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officers cited the Five Mourning Grades Edict: "Three-year qi mourning—for an heir to the grandfather, when the grandfather dies, for the grandmother.

sentences.zh: 又曰：『齊衰不杖 期，為祖父母。』

translations.literal: It also says: 'Qi mourning without staff, one-year period—for grandparents.'
translations.idiomatic: It also lists one-year qi mourning without staff for grandparents.'

sentences.zh: 《注》云：『父之所生庶母亦同，惟為祖後者不服。』

translations.literal: The Commentary says: 'The father's birth-giving concubine mother is the same, except one who succeeds as heir to the grandfather does not wear mourning.'
translations.idiomatic: The commentary adds that a father's concubine birth mother is treated the same, except an heir to the grandfather is exempt.'

sentences.zh: 又按《通禮義纂》：『為祖後者，父所生庶母亡，合三年否？』

translations.literal: Again according to Comprehensive Rites Meaning Compendium: 'One who succeeds as heir to the grandfather—when the father's birth-giving concubine mother dies, should it be three years or not?'
translations.idiomatic: The Comprehensive Rites Compendium asks whether an heir to the grandfather should mourn a father's concubine birth mother for three years.'

sentences.zh: 《記》云：『為祖母也，為 後三年。

translations.literal: The Record says: 'For the grandmother also—for one who succeeds as heir, three years.'
translations.idiomatic: Its Record states that an heir mourns a grandmother for three years.

sentences.zh: 不言嫡庶。

translations.literal: It does not distinguish principal from concubine.
translations.idiomatic: It makes no distinction between principal and concubine status.

sentences.zh: 然奉宗廟，當以貴賤為差，庶祖母不祔於皇姑，已受重於祖，當為祭主，不得申於私恩；

translations.literal: Yet in serving the ancestral temple, rank and status should be the distinction. A concubine grandmother is not enshrined with the principal grandmother-in-law. Having already received the heavy obligation from the grandfather, one should be sacrificial host and may not extend private affection;
translations.idiomatic: Yet in ancestral rites rank mattered: a concubine grandmother was not enshrined beside the principal grandmother-in-law. One who had already borne the grandfather's ritual weight served as sacrificial host and could not indulge private feeling;

sentences.zh: 若受重於父代而養，為後可也。』

translations.literal: If one received the heavy obligation from the father in his stead and was raised as heir, it is permissible.'
translations.idiomatic: Only if one had received the father's ritual weight in his place and been raised as heir would mourning be allowed.'

sentences.zh: 又曰：『庶祖母合從 何服？

translations.literal: It also says: 'For a concubine grandmother, what mourning should one follow?'
translations.idiomatic: It further asks what mourning a concubine grandmother requires.

sentences.zh: 禮無服庶祖母之文，有為祖庶母後者之服。

translations.literal: The rites have no text on mourning for a concubine grandmother, but there is mourning for one who succeeds as heir to the grandfather's concubine mother.
translations.idiomatic: The classics say nothing about mourning a concubine grandmother, but they do prescribe garb for an heir to a grandfather's concubine wife.

sentences.zh: 晉王暠議曰：受命為後，則服之無嫌。

translations.literal: Wang Gao of Jin argued: Having received the mandate to succeed as heir, then to wear mourning is without objection.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gao of Jin argued that one appointed heir could mourn without impropriety.

sentences.zh: 婦人無子，托後族人，猶為之服，況其子孫乎？

translations.literal: When a woman has no son and entrusts succession to a clansman, one still wears mourning for her—how much more so for her sons and grandsons?
translations.idiomatic: When a childless woman entrusted the line to a kinsman, mourners still observed rites for her—how much more should her own descendants?

sentences.zh: 人莫敢卑其祖也。

translations.literal: No one dares demean his ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: No one would slight his own forebear.

sentences.zh: 且妾子， 父歿為母得申三年。

translations.literal: Moreover a concubine's son, when the father dies, may extend mourning for the mother to three years.
translations.idiomatic: A concubine's son, moreover, could mourn his mother three years after his father's death.

sentences.zh: 孫無由獨屈，當服之也。』

translations.literal: The grandson has no reason to alone abase himself—he should wear mourning.'
translations.idiomatic: A grandson could hardly stand alone in refusing what his father would have observed.'

sentences.zh: 看詳《五服年月敕》，不載持重之文，於《義纂》即有所據。

translations.literal: On careful review, the Five Mourning Grades Year-and-Month Edict does not contain text on bearing the heavy obligation; in the Meaning Compendium there is basis.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Mourning Grades Edict says nothing about bearing ritual weight, but the Meaning Compendium offered grounds for a ruling.

sentences.zh: 今薛紳不為祖後，受重於父，合申三年之制。」

translations.literal: Now Xue Shen is not one who succeeds as heir to the grandfather; he received the heavy obligation from the father. He should follow the three-year regulation."
translations.idiomatic: Xue Shen was not heir to the grandfather but had received his father's ritual weight; he should observe three years' mourning."

sentences.zh: 史館檢討、同知太常禮院王洙言：「《五服年月敕》與新定令文及《通禮》正文內五服制度，皆聖朝典法，此三處並無為父所生庶母服三年之文。

translations.literal: Wang Zhu, Compiler-Reviewer of the Historiography Institute and Associate Director of the Directorate of Ceremonies Board of Ritual, stated: "The Five Mourning Grades Year-and-Month Edict, the newly fixed statute text, and the main text of Comprehensive Rites on the five-mourning-grade system are all canonical law of the sacred dynasty. In these three places there is no text on three years' mourning for the father's birth-giving concubine mother.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhu, historiographer and associate director of the Ritual Academy, argued: "The Five Mourning Grades Edict, the revised statutes, and the Comprehensive Rites—all current dynastic law—nowhere prescribe three years' mourning for a father's concubine birth mother.

sentences.zh: 唯《義纂》者是 唐世蕭嵩、王仲丘等撰集，非創修之書，未可據以決事。

translations.literal: Only the Meaning Compendium was compiled by Xiao Song, Wang Zhongqiu, and others of the Tang era—it is not a newly drafted book and may not be relied on to decide cases.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Meaning Compendium—a Tang compilation by Xiao Song and Wang Zhongqiu—was not original legislation and could not govern the case.

sentences.zh: 且所引兩條，皆近世諸儒之說，不出於《六經》，臣已別狀奏駁。

translations.literal: Moreover the two passages cited are all sayings of recent Confucian scholars and do not come from the Six Classics. Your subject has already submitted a separate memorial rebutting them.
translations.idiomatic: The two passages cited were recent scholarly opinions, not drawn from the Six Classics; he had already memorialized separately to refute them.

sentences.zh: 今薛紳為映之孫，耀卿為別子始祖，紳繼 別之後為大宗，所守至重，非如次庶子等承傳其重者也。

translations.literal: Now Xue Shen is the grandson of Ying. Yaoqing was the founding ancestor of a separate branch. Shen succeeded after the separate branch and became great lineage head. What he upholds is supremely heavy—not like secondary sons and concubine sons who inherit and transmit its weight.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Shen was grandson of Ying; Yaoqing had founded a separate branch, and Shen succeeded as great-lineage heir—a burden far heavier than that of a younger or concubine son who merely inherited a father's ritual weight.

sentences.zh: 不可輒服父所生庶母三年之喪，以廢始祖之祭也。

translations.literal: He may not rashly wear three years' mourning for the father's birth-giving concubine mother and thereby abolish sacrifice to the founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: He must not don three years' mourning for a concubine birth mother at the cost of abandoning sacrifice to the founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 臣謹按《禮經》所謂重者，皆承後之文。

translations.literal: Your subject respectfully notes that what the Ritual Classics call heavy obligation is all text on succeeding as heir.
translations.idiomatic: In the Ritual Classics, he noted, every mention of 'bearing weight' referred to succeeding as heir.

sentences.zh: 據《義纂》稱重 於父，亦有二說：一者，嫡長子自為正體，受重可知；

translations.literal: According to the Meaning Compendium's phrase receiving the heavy obligation from the father, there are also two interpretations: first, the principal eldest son is himself the legitimate body—the heavy obligation received is clear;
translations.idiomatic: The Compendium's phrase 'receiving weight from the father' admitted two readings: the principal eldest son, as legitimate heir, clearly bore that weight;

sentences.zh: 二者，或嫡長亡，取嫡或庶次承傳父重，亦名為受重也。

translations.literal: Second, if the principal eldest dies, selecting a principal or concubine younger son to inherit and transmit the father's weight is also called receiving the heavy obligation.
translations.idiomatic: or, if the eldest son died, a younger principal or concubine son who inherited the father's ritual burden was also said to 'receive weight.'

sentences.zh: 若繼別子之後，自為大宗，所承至重，不得更遠係庶 祖母為之服三年，惟其父以生己之故，為之三年可也。

translations.literal: If one succeeds after a separate-branch son and becomes great lineage head himself, what he inherits is supremely heavy. He may not further extend ties to a concubine grandmother and wear three years for her. Only his father, because she bore him, may wear three years for her.
translations.idiomatic: One who succeeded a separate-branch founder as great-lineage head bore a supremely heavy obligation and could not extend three years' mourning to a concubine grandmother; only his father, because she had borne him, might do so.

sentences.zh: 詳《義纂》所謂『受重於父者』，指嫡長子亡、次子承傳父重者也，但其文不同耳。」

translations.literal: In detail, what the Meaning Compendium calls 'one who received the heavy obligation from the father' refers to when the principal eldest son dies and a younger son inherits and transmits the father's weight—only the wording differs."
translations.idiomatic: The Compendium's 'receiving weight from the father,' he concluded, meant a younger son inheriting after the eldest died—the wording merely differed."

sentences.zh: 詔太常禮 院與御史臺詳定聞奏。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Directorate of Ceremonies Board of Ritual and the Censorate to examine in detail and report.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the Ritual Academy and Censorate to review the case and report back.

sentences.zh: 眾官參詳：「耀卿，王氏子；

translations.literal: The assembled officials jointly examined: "Yaoqing was Wang's son;
translations.idiomatic: After joint review the officials held: "Yaoqing was Wang's son;

sentences.zh: 紳，王氏孫，尤親於慈母、庶母，祖母、庶祖母也，耀卿既亡，紳受重代養，當服之也。

translations.literal: Shen was Wang's grandson—especially close as to a nurturing mother or concubine mother, grandmother or concubine grandmother. Yaoqing having died, Shen received the heavy obligation in his stead and was raised—he should wear mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Shen was Wang's grandson, closer to her than to a mere stepmother or concubine grandmother. With Yaoqing dead, Shen had borne her ritual weight and been raised by her—he should mourn.

sentences.zh: 又薛紳頃因籍田覃恩， 乞將敘封母氏恩澤，回授與故父所生母王氏，其薛紳官爵未合敘封祖母，蓋朝廷以耀卿已亡，紳是長孫，敦以教道，特許封邑，豈可王氏生則輒邀國恩，歿則不受重 服？

translations.literal: Moreover Xue Shen recently, because of the general amnesty at the plowing ceremony, begged to transfer the enfeoffment favor for his mother to his late father's birth-giving mother Wang. Xue Shen's rank and title were not properly eligible for enfeoffment of a grandmother. Presumably the court, because Yaoqing had died and Shen was the eldest grandson, urged moral instruction and specially permitted an enfeoffment. How can Wang while living readily seek state favor, yet when dead not receive heavy-obligation mourning?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, at a recent plowing-ceremony amnesty Shen had asked to redirect enfeoffment honors meant for his mother to his late father's birth mother Wang—a rank that normally could not enfeoff a grandmother. The court had granted it because Yaoqing was dead and Shen, as eldest grandson, deserved moral encouragement. How could Wang seek imperial favor in life yet be denied full mourning in death?

sentences.zh: 況紳被王氏鞠育之恩，體尊義重，合令解官持齊衰三年之服。」

translations.literal: Moreover Shen received Wang's nurturing grace. In person he is honored and in obligation heavy. He should be ordered to resign office and wear three years' qi mourning."
translations.idiomatic: Shen owed Wang the debt of her upbringing; propriety demanded that he resign and observe three years' qi mourning."

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: The edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 皇祐元年，大理評事石祖仁奏：「叔從簡為祖父中立服後四十日亡，乞下禮院定承祖父重服。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangyou, Reviewing Policy Advisor Shi Zuren of the Court of Judicial Review memorialized: "My paternal uncle Congjian served as heir for my grandfather Zhongli and died forty days later. I beg that the Board of Ritual be ordered to determine mourning for bearing the grandfather's heavy obligation."
translations.idiomatic: In Huangyou 1 (1049), Shi Zuren, a reviewing policy advisor at the Court of Judicial Review, reported: "My uncle Congjian became heir to our grandfather Zhongli but died forty days later. I ask the Ritual Academy to rule on the proper heir-mourning garb."

sentences.zh: 禮官宋敏求議曰：「自《開元禮》以前，嫡孫卒則次孫承重，況從簡為中子已卒，而祖仁為嫡孫乎？

translations.literal: Ritual official Song Minqiu deliberated: "Before the Kaiyuan Ritual, when the principal grandson died the next grandson bore the heavy obligation—how much more so when Congjian was the middle son already dead and Zuren is the principal grandson?
translations.idiomatic: Ritual official Song Minqiu replied: "Before the Kaiyuan Ritual, when the principal grandson died the next grandson bore the weight; here Congjian, the middle son, was already dead and Zuren was the principal grandson.

sentences.zh: 古者重嫡，正貴所傳，其為後者皆服三年，以主虞、練、祥、禫之祭。

translations.literal: In antiquity the principal line was honored; what the rightful noble transmitted—those who became heirs all wore three years' mourning to preside over the yu, lian, xiang, and chan sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Antiquity honored the principal line: heirs wore three years' mourning to lead the yu, lian, xiang, and chan rites.

sentences.zh: 且三年之喪，必以日月之久而服之者有變也。

translations.literal: Moreover three years' mourning necessarily changes according to the passage of days and months.
translations.idiomatic: Three-year mourning also changed with the passage of time.

sentences.zh: 今中立未及卒哭，從簡已卒，是日月未久而服未經變也。

translations.literal: Now Zhongli had not yet reached the end of wailing when Congjian died—this is that days and months had not long passed and mourning had not yet changed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongli had not yet completed wailing when Congjian died, so little time had passed and the mourning period had not yet changed.

sentences.zh: 或謂已服期，不當改服斬，而更為重製。

translations.literal: Some say that having already worn one-year mourning, one should not change to zhan mourning but instead make heavy mourning anew.
translations.idiomatic: Some argued that after one-year mourning he should not switch to zhan but simply renew the heavy mourning.

sentences.zh: 按《儀禮》：『子嫁，反在父之室，為父三年。』

translations.literal: According to the Ceremonies: 'When a daughter marries and returns to her father's house, she wears three years' mourning for her father.'
translations.idiomatic: The Ceremonies state: "If a daughter marries out but returns to her father's house, she wears three years' mourning for her father."

sentences.zh: 鄭氏注：『謂遭喪而出者，始服齊衰期，出而虞則以三年之喪。』

translations.literal: Master Zheng's commentary: 'This refers to one who encountered mourning and went out—at first wearing qi mourning for one year; when going out for the yu rite, then wearing three years' mourning.'
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan commented: "This means one who left home in mourning first wore one-year qi mourning, but after the yu rite wore three years' mourning."

sentences.zh: 是服可再製明矣。

translations.literal: Thus it is clear that mourning may be made anew.
translations.idiomatic: So mourning could clearly be renewed.

sentences.zh: 今祖仁宜解官，因其葬而製斬衰三年。

translations.literal: Now Zuren should resign office and, because of the burial, make zhan mourning for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Zuren should resign and, at the burial, take up three years' zhan mourning.

sentences.zh: 後有如其類而已葬者，用再喪製服。」

translations.literal: Later cases like this that are already buried should use renewed mourning dress."
translations.idiomatic: Later similar cases already buried should follow the rule of renewed mourning dress."

sentences.zh: 遂著為定式。

translations.literal: Thereupon it was established as a fixed formula.
translations.idiomatic: This was then fixed as standard practice.

sentences.zh: 熙寧八年，禮院請為祖承重者依《封爵令》立嫡孫，以次立嫡子同母弟，無母 弟立庶子，無庶子立嫡孫同母弟；

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xining, the Board of Ritual requested that for one who bears the heavy obligation for the grandfather, a rightful grandson be established according to the Enfeoffment and Rank Statutes; failing that, establish a principal son's younger brother of the same mother; if no younger brother of the same mother, establish a concubine son; if no concubine son, establish a rightful grandson's younger brother of the same mother;
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 8 (1075), the Ritual Academy proposed that heirs bearing a grandfather's ritual weight follow the Enfeoffment Statutes: first a principal grandson, then a principal son's younger full brother, then a concubine son, then a principal grandson's younger full brother;

sentences.zh: 如又無之，即立庶長孫，行斬衰服。

translations.literal: If again there is none, then establish the eldest concubine grandson and perform zhan mourning.
translations.idiomatic: and if none remained, the eldest concubine grandson would succeed and wear zhan mourning.

sentences.zh: 於是禮房詳定：「古者封建國邑而立宗子，故周禮適子死，雖有諸子，猶令嫡孫傳重，所以一 本統、明尊尊之義也。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Ritual Office examined in detail: "In antiquity feudal domains and fiefs were enfeoffed and lineage heads established. Therefore in Zhou rites, when the rightful son died, though there were other sons, the rightful grandson was still made to transmit the weight—thereby unifying the single root lineage and clarifying the principle of honoring the honored.
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Office then ruled: "Ancient enfeoffment had established lineage heads, so Zhou practice kept the principal grandson as heir even when other sons survived—preserving a single ancestral line and the hierarchy of honor.

sentences.zh: 至於商禮，則嫡子死立眾子，然後立孫。

translations.literal: As for Shang rites, when the rightful son died one established the multitude of sons, and only then established a grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Under Shang practice, when the principal son died a younger son succeeded first and only then a grandson.

sentences.zh: 今既不立宗子，又未嘗封建國邑，則嫡孫喪祖，不宜純用周禮。

translations.literal: Now since lineage heads are no longer established and feudal domains and fiefs have never been enfeoffed, when the rightful grandson mourns the grandfather, pure Zhou rites should not be used.
translations.idiomatic: Since the dynasty no longer enfeoffed lineage heads or domains, a principal grandson mourning a grandfather should not follow Zhou rites alone.

sentences.zh: 若嫡子死無眾子，然後嫡孫承重，即 嫡孫傳襲封爵者，雖有眾子猶承重。」

translations.literal: If the rightful son dies and there are no other sons, then the rightful grandson bears the heavy obligation. As for the rightful grandson who inherits and transmits enfeoffment and rank, though there are other sons he still bears the heavy obligation."
translations.idiomatic: Only when the principal son died without other sons should the principal grandson bear the weight—but a principal grandson who inherited a title bore it even if other sons survived."

sentences.zh: 時知廬州孫覺以嫡孫解官持祖母服，覺叔父在，有司以新令，乃改知潤州。

translations.literal: At the time Sun Jue, prefect of Luzhou, resigned office as rightful grandson to observe mourning for his grandmother. Jue's paternal uncle was living. The relevant offices, applying the new statute, then transferred him to prefect of Runzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Jue of Luzhou had resigned as principal grandson to mourn his grandmother; because his uncle was still alive, the authorities applied the new rule and reassigned him to Runzhou.

sentences.zh: 元豐三年，太常丞劉次莊祖母亡，有嫡曾孫，次莊為嫡孫同母弟，在法未有庶孫承重之文。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanfeng, Vice Director of the Directorate of Ceremonies Liu Cizhuang's grandmother died. There was a rightful great-grandson. Cizhuang was a rightful grandson's younger brother of the same mother. In the law there was no text on a concubine grandson bearing the heavy obligation.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yuanfeng (1080), when Vice Director Liu Cizhuang's grandmother died, a principal great-grandson existed; Cizhuang was a principal grandson's younger full brother, and the law had no provision for a concubine grandson bearing ritual weight.

sentences.zh: 詔下禮官立法：「自今承重者，嫡子死無諸子，即嫡孫承重；

translations.literal: An edict was sent down to the ritual officials to legislate: "From now on for one who bears the heavy obligation: when the rightful son dies with no other sons, then the rightful grandson bears the heavy obligation;
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered ritual officers to codify the rule: "Henceforth, when the principal son dies without other sons, the principal grandson bears the weight;

sentences.zh: 無嫡孫，嫡孫同母弟承重；

translations.literal: If there is no rightful grandson, a rightful grandson's younger brother of the same mother bears the heavy obligation;
translations.idiomatic: if no principal grandson exists, a principal grandson's younger full brother;

sentences.zh: 無母弟，庶孫長者承重；

translations.literal: If there is no younger brother of the same mother, the eldest concubine grandson bears the heavy obligation;
translations.idiomatic: if no full brother, the eldest concubine grandson;

sentences.zh: 曾孫以下準此。

translations.literal: For great-grandsons and below, apply this by analogy.
translations.idiomatic: the same order applied to great-grandsons and below.

sentences.zh: 其傳襲封爵，自依禮、令。」

translations.literal: As for inheriting and transmitting enfeoffment and rank, follow the rites and statutes on their own."
translations.idiomatic: Inheritance of titles still followed the rites and statutes separately."

sentences.zh: 雜議。

translations.literal: Miscellaneous deliberations.
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous Cases

sentences.zh: 大中祥符八年，廣平公德彝聘王顯孫女，將大歸而德彝卒，疑其禮制。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Duke of Guangping Degong betrothed the granddaughter of Wang Xian. She was about to go to the great return when Degong died. There was doubt about the ritual regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong Xiangfu 8 (1015), the Duke of Guangping, Degong, betrothed Wang Xian's granddaughter; Degong died just before the wedding, raising questions of proper mourning.

sentences.zh: 禮官言：「按《禮》：『曾子問曰：娶女有吉日而女死，如之何？

translations.literal: The ritual officials stated: "According to the Rites: 'Zengzi asked: When there is an auspicious day for marrying a woman and the woman dies, what is to be done?
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officers cited the Rites: "Zengzi asked what to do when a betrothed bride died on the eve of the wedding.

sentences.zh: 孔子曰：婿齊衰而 吊，既葬而除之。

translations.literal: Confucius said: The son-in-law wears qi mourning and pays a condolence visit; after burial he removes it.
translations.idiomatic: Confucius answered that the groom should wear qi mourning, pay a condolence visit, and lay the garb aside after burial.

sentences.zh: 夫死亦如之。』

translations.literal: When the husband dies it is likewise.'
translations.idiomatic: The same rule applied when the groom died.'

sentences.zh: 《注》云：『謂無期三年之恩也，女服斬衰。』

translations.literal: The Commentary says: 'This means there is no one-year or three-year bond of affection; the woman wears zhan mourning.'
translations.idiomatic: The commentary explained that no full marital bond had yet formed; the woman wore zhan mourning.'

sentences.zh: 又《刑統》云：『依禮，有三月廟見、有未廟見就婚等三種之文，妻並同夫法，其 有克吉日及定婚夫等，惟不得違約改嫁，自餘相犯，並同凡人。』

translations.literal: Again the Penal Code Comprehensive says: 'According to the rites, there are three categories of text: three-month temple presentation, not yet having temple presentation before proceeding to marriage, and the like. The wife in all cases follows the husband's law. Where there is selection of an auspicious day and betrothal of the husband and the like, only violating the agreement and remarrying is forbidden; for other offenses, all follow ordinary persons.'
translations.idiomatic: The Penal Code added that under rites covering temple presentation, pre-presentation marriage, and related cases, a wife followed her husband's status; betrothed couples could not break engagement to remarry, but other offenses were judged as between ordinary persons.'

sentences.zh: 今詳女合服斬衰於室，既葬而除；

translations.literal: Now on detailed review, the woman should wear zhan mourning at home and remove it after burial;
translations.idiomatic: They ruled that the bride should wear zhan mourning at home and lay it aside after burial;

sentences.zh: 或未葬，但出欑即除之。」

translations.literal: or if not yet buried, remove it as soon as the coffin is taken out."
translations.idiomatic: or, if burial had not yet occurred, as soon as the coffin left the house."

sentences.zh: 天聖七年，興化軍進士 陳可言：「臣昨與本軍進士黃價同保，臣預解送之後，本軍言黃價昨赴舉時，有叔為僧，喪服未滿，臣例當駁放。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tiansheng, Presented Scholar Chen Keyan of Xinghua Circuit stated: "Your subject yesterday together with Presented Scholar Huang Jia of this circuit served as mutual guarantor. After your subject had passed the preliminary sending-up, this circuit reported that when Huang Jia went to take the examination, he had an uncle who was a monk and whose mourning period was not yet complete. By regulation your subject should be rejected and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiansheng 7 (1029), Chen Keyan, a presented scholar of Xinghua Circuit, reported: "I had vouched for fellow scholar Huang Jia. After I passed the preliminary exam, the circuit said Huang Jia's uncle was a monk still in mourning when Huang took the test—by rule I should be disqualified too.

sentences.zh: 竊思出家製服，禮律俱無明文，況僧犯大罪，並無 緣坐；

translations.literal: Privately I consider that leaving home and making mourning dress—neither rites nor law have explicit text. Moreover when a monk commits a great crime, there is no guilt by association;
translations.idiomatic: Leaving home, I reasoned, had no explicit mourning rule in rites or law; monks who committed grave crimes incurred no guilt by association;

sentences.zh: 犯事還俗，準敕不得均分父母田園。

translations.literal: when one commits an offense and returns to lay life, by edict one may not equally divide parents' fields and gardens.
translations.idiomatic: and monks who returned to lay life after misconduct were barred by edict from sharing equally in parental property.

sentences.zh: 又釋門儀式，見父母不拜，居父母喪不絰，死則法門弟子為之制服，其於本族並無服式。

translations.literal: Again in Buddhist ceremonial practice, seeing parents one does not bow; dwelling in parents' mourning one does not wear the hemp headband; when one dies, Dharma-gate disciples make mourning dress for one. Toward one's own clan there is no mourning form at all.
translations.idiomatic: Buddhist practice forbade bowing to parents, wearing mourning headbands for them, or clan mourning rites—only fellow disciples observed funeral garb.

sentences.zh: 望下禮官詳議，許其赴試。」

translations.literal: I hope the matter will be sent down to the ritual officials for detailed deliberation and that he be permitted to take the examination."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that ritual officers review the case and allow Huang to sit the exam."

sentences.zh: 太 常禮院言：「檢會敕文，期周尊長服，不得取應。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Ceremonies Board of Ritual stated: "On checking edict texts, one-year mourning for honored elders within the mourning circle—one may not take the examination.
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Academy replied: "Edicts bar candidates still in one-year mourning for elders within the mourning circle.

sentences.zh: 又禮為叔父齊衰期，外繼者降服大功九月。

translations.literal: Again by rites, mourning for a paternal uncle is one-year qi mourning; for one who succeeds from outside the line, mourning is reduced to greater merit for nine months.
translations.idiomatic: Rites prescribe one-year qi mourning for a paternal uncle, but an heir from outside the line wears reduced greater-merit mourning for nine months.

sentences.zh: 其黃價為叔僧，合比外繼，降服大功。」

translations.literal: Huang Jia's uncle being a monk should be compared to outside succession and wear reduced greater merit."
translations.idiomatic: Huang Jia's monk uncle should be treated like an outside heir—reduced to greater-merit mourning."

sentences.zh: 皇祐四年，吉州司理參軍祝紳幼孤，鞠於兄嫂。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Huangyou, Legal Assistant Zhu Shen of Jizhou was orphaned young and was nurtured by elder brother and sister-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangyou 4 (1052), Zhu Shen, a legal assistant in Jizhou, had been orphaned young and raised by his elder brother and sister-in-law.

sentences.zh: 已嘗為嫂持服，兄喪，又請解官持喪。

translations.literal: He had already once worn mourning for his sister-in-law. At his elder brother's death he again requested to resign office and observe mourning.
translations.idiomatic: He had already mourned his sister-in-law; when his brother died he again asked to resign and observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 有司以為言。

translations.literal: The relevant offices reported on it.
translations.idiomatic: The authorities raised the matter with the throne.

sentences.zh: 仁宗曰：「近世蓋有匿親喪而幹進者。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong said: "In recent times there have surely been those who concealed relatives' mourning yet sought advancement.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong said: "Lately many have hidden bereavements to pursue office.

sentences.zh: 紳雖所服非禮，然不忘鞠養恩，亦可勸也。

translations.literal: Shen, though what he wears mourning for is not according to rites, yet does not forget the grace of nurturing—this may also be encouraged.
translations.idiomatic: Shen's mourning may be irregular, but his gratitude for being raised deserves encouragement.

sentences.zh: 候服闋日與幕職、知縣。」

translations.literal: Wait until the day mourning is complete, then grant a staff post and county magistracy."
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning ends, give him a staff post and a county magistracy."

sentences.zh: 繼絕。

translations.literal: Continuing broken lines.
translations.idiomatic: Continuing Broken Lines

sentences.zh: 熙寧二年，同修起居注、直史館蔡延慶父褒，故太尉齊之弟也。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xining, Associate Compiler of the Diary of Activity and Attendant of the Historiography Institute Cai Yanqing's father Bao was the younger brother of the former Grand Marshal Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 2 (1069), Cai Yanqing, associate compiler of the imperial diary and attendant at the Historiography Institute, sought recognition for his father Bao, younger brother of the former Grand Marshal Qi.

sentences.zh: 齊初無子，子延慶。

translations.literal: At first Qi had no son and made Yanqing his son.
translations.idiomatic: Qi had initially had no son and had adopted Yanqing.

sentences.zh: 後齊有子，而褒絕，請復本宗。

translations.literal: Later Qi had a son, and Bao's line was broken; he requested restoration to his original clan.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi later had a son of his own, Bao's line was cut off, and he asked to return to his original clan.

sentences.zh: 禮官以請，許之。

translations.literal: Ritual officials submitted the request and it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials approved the request.

sentences.zh: 紹聖元年，尚書省言：「元祐南郊赦文，戶絕之家，近親不為立繼者，官為施行。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaosheng, the Ministry of Revenue stated: "In the Yuanyou Southern Suburban amnesty text, for households with extinct lines where close kin did not establish an heir, the state would act.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaosheng 1 (1094) the Ministry of Revenue stated: "The Yuanyou Southern Suburban amnesty allowed the state to act when close kin failed to establish an heir for a household with an extinct line.

sentences.zh: 今戶絕家許近親尊長命繼，已有著令，即不當官為施行。」

translations.literal: Now households with extinct lines permit close kin and honored elders to appoint heirs; there is already established statute, so the state should not act."
translations.idiomatic: Statute now allowed close elders to appoint heirs for such households, so state action was no longer appropriate."

sentences.zh: 四年，右武衛大將軍克務，乞故登州防禦使東牟侯克端子叔博為嗣，請赴期朝參起居，而不為克端服。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Right Martial Guard General Kewu requested that Shubo, son of the former Dengzhou defense commissioner and Dongmou Marquis Keduan, be made heir; he asked to attend court audience on schedule but not wear mourning for Keduan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the reign, Right Martial Guard General Kewu asked to adopt Keduan's son Shubo as heir and to resume court attendance on schedule without mourning Keduan.

sentences.zh: 大宗正司以聞。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Imperial Clan Affairs reported it.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Clan Directorate reported the case.

sentences.zh: 下禮官議，宜終喪三年。

translations.literal: It was sent down to ritual officials for deliberation; they should complete mourning for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials ruled that he should complete three years' mourning.

sentences.zh: 遂詔宗室居父母喪者，毋得乞為繼嗣。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict declared that imperial clansmen dwelling in parents' mourning might not petition to become heirs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then barred clansmen in parental mourning from petitioning to become heirs.

sentences.zh: 大觀四 年，詔曰：「孔子謂興滅繼絕，天下之民歸心。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Daguan, an edict stated: "Confucius said that reviving what was extinguished and continuing what was broken off— the people of the realm turn their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: In Daguan 4 (1110), an edict cited Confucius: "To revive extinguished lines and continue broken ones is to win the people's hearts.

sentences.zh: 王安石子雱無嗣，有族子棣，已嘗用安石孫恩例官，可以棣為雱後，以稱朕善善之意。」

translations.literal: Wang Anshi's son Bian had no heir. There is a clansman Di, who has already once used the Wang Anshi grandson favor precedent for office. Di may be made Bian's heir, thereby matching Our intent to favor the worthy."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi's son Bian had no heir; a kinsman Di, already promoted under the Anshi-grandson privilege, may succeed Bian—fulfilling Our wish to honor merit."

sentences.zh: 先是，元豐國子博士孟開， 請以侄孫宗顏為孫，據晉侍中荀顗無子，以兄之孫為孫；

translations.literal: Earlier, in Yuanfeng, Doctor of the Imperial University Meng Kai requested to make his nephew's son Zongyan his son, citing Jin Palace Attendant Xun Yi, who had no son and made his elder brother's grandson his son;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in Yuanfeng, Imperial University doctor Meng Kai had asked to adopt his nephew's son Zongyan, citing Jin minister Xun Yi, who had adopted his brother's grandson when childless;

sentences.zh: 其後王彥林請以弟彥通為叔母宋繼絕孫，詔皆如所請。

translations.literal: afterward Wang Yanlin requested to make his younger brother Yantong the heir to continue the broken line for his paternal aunt Song. Edicts in each case approved as requested.
translations.idiomatic: later Wang Yanlin had asked to make his brother Yantong heir to his childless aunt Song—both petitions had been granted.

sentences.zh: 淳熙四年十月二十七日，戶部言：「知蜀州吳擴申 明：乞自今養同宗昭穆相當之子，夫死之後，不許其妻非理遣還。

translations.literal: On the twenty-seventh day of the tenth month of the fourth year of Chunxi, the Ministry of Revenue stated: "Prefect of Shuzhou Wu Kuo reported clearly: I beg that from now on when one adopts a son of the same clan with matching generation and branch, after the husband dies his wife may not unreasonably send the adopted son away.
translations.idiomatic: On Chunxi 4, tenth month, day 27 (1177), the Ministry of Revenue reported: "Shuzhou prefect Wu Kuo asked that when a couple adopted a clansman of matching generation, the widow might not arbitrarily dismiss the adoptee after her husband's death.

sentences.zh: 若所養子破蕩家產，不能侍養，實有顯過，即聽所養母訴官，近親尊長證驗得實，依條遣還，仍公 共繼嗣。」

translations.literal: If the adopted son squanders the family property, cannot serve and support, and truly has conspicuous faults, then let the adopting mother sue at court; when close kin and honored elders verify and establish the facts, send him away according to statute and still have the clan jointly continue the succession."
translations.idiomatic: If the adoptee squandered the estate, failed to support her, and had clear fault, the adopting mother might sue; with verification by close kin, he could be sent away under statute while the clan still maintained the succession line."
